newsitem.title: USA: Capstone expands bank credit to $125 mln.
newsitem.headline: Capstone expands bank credit to $125 mln.

text.p: Capstone Pharmacy Services Inc said it expanded its bank credit facility to $125 million of five-year revolving credit from $35 million.
The company said it would use the extra credit to expand into new markets, such as those in metropolitan areas, by making acquisitions.
Bankers Trust is the facility's agent, Capstone said.
Mellon Bank, CoreStates, Creditanstalt Corporate Finance Inc, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and the Bank of Montreal are also participating in the facility, Capstone added.
